name: io.github.thomas-villani/wordlive
title: wordlive (Microsoft Word, live)
description: Read and edit the Microsoft Word document you have open right now, live, over COM.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Selects the optional extras: `mcp` pulls in the MCP SDK, `snapshot` adds PyMuPDF for the page-rendering tool. Equivalently, `uvx "wordlive[mcp,snapshot]" mcp`.

packageArguments.description: Runs the stdio MCP server. Same server as the `wordlive-mcp` console script; accepts --save-dir / --image-dir to configure the filesystem gate on the launch line.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.requires: A running Microsoft Word (Windows). The server drives the live instance over COM; it does not open or convert .docx files on its own.
